name: mcp-google-contacts
description: A remote MCP server for Google Contacts, deployed on Cloudflare Workers, that enables Claude to create, search, list, get, and update your Google contacts via the People API. Designed as a custom connector for claude.ai, it supports OAuth and can extract contact details from business card photos.
